subject: STABLE-ish air-compute-opus #2: 32-lane simdgroup emulation (CA compute_apl_fast now compiles via AIR), producer receipt 7/7 on AIR path; special CA classes need a root decision
body: (1) mali_compute_air.inc: Metal 32-lane simdgroups on 16-lane Valhall: builtins lin&31 / lin>>5 / ceil(N/32) (m2v's own derivation); reduce/vote/broadcast_first/shuffle computed per warp and exchanged with the partner warp through appended threadgroup scratch (per-warp counter + double-buffered slot, shared atomics), ONLY where control flow is simdgroup-uniform (own fixpoint analysis); otherwise refused. CA compute_apl_fast: region compile OK, manifest identical to m2v, WLS 256+144. Host Mali rebuilt d80c288f; iOS Mali rebuilding now. (2) Bridge: NEW tegu_air_pipeline_variant_metadata (air_bridge.rs d4d0e96b, .h 46489969); host cdylib 27a84fbc rebuilt, iOS staticlib rebuilt OK. runtime_pipeline.inc uses it for TGP2 dispatch variants. (3) check_compute_v2_real_producer.py: additive --air flag (compiles each planned region through tegu_mali_compile_compute_air with base/variant metadata, same checks): 7/7 PASS (gpu/build/air-compute-20261028/producer-air). UI+CA replay: 343/373 region compiles via AIR, remaining refusals = simd_shuffle_down in the AIR frontend (16 CoreImage portrait/photo-style, non-SpringBoard), 4 CA tile functions (tegu_air_tile_pipeline_create has NO runtime caller), 2 descriptor arrays, 2 pointer phis, 1 BicubicTexels, 1 simdgroup.barrier, 1 repack bitcast, 1 slot-without-binding. (4) SPECIAL CLASSES, finding: fixed-UI R80/R85, compositor V6/V7/B3, attachment-clear, blur3, home-affordance packages are still DRAWN by the encoder (fixedUiSnapshotOnly / compositorSnapshotOnly / attachmentClearSnapshotOnly paths, render_encoder.inc ~4130/4327/2501), and all compile via compile_pair from m2v SPIR-V with class-specific resource lowering (mali_graphics_compiler.c, owner air-render-plan-opus/lowering) and the check_* scripts use hand-written GLSL fixtures + (attachment clear) SPIR-V package identity. A faithful AIR port = per-class AIR->vulkan-deref NIR shim in front of compile_pair (big, touches lowering's file). Cheaper alternative under AIR-only + GENERIC_JOB: create those pipelines only through the generic AIR path (already prepared for most via tegu_render_generic_prepare/retranslate) and stop setting the *SnapshotOnly flags, so the encoder draws them generically. ROOT: which do you want? I will not touch render_pipeline.inc/render_encoder.inc/mali_graphics_compiler.c without your call.
